navigationNote: Drive to Spruce ramp and park there. Paddle roughly 3–4 miles upstream to the spring, then return downstream. The surrounding shore is private. Current, clarity and rope-swing condition are unknown.
experience: A paddle on the Withlacoochee to a blue spring basin off the river, used as a summer swimming hole, with a rope swing listed on a popular Florida springs map. After rain it can look more green than blue.

Turner Camp boat ramp is about 5.5 miles upstream. The pin is the spring itself, not a parking spot.
